archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / HOLOGRAPHIC TACTICAL COMMAND

entry_surfaces./: tactical HUD canvas workspace with top holographic team bar, interactive canvas center with pan/zoom/arrows/hotspots, and tactical squad assignment side console/bottom drawer

layout_and_grids.philosophy: Tactical Battle Center with high-density holographic HUD frames, responsive split workspace desktop, and bottom-sheet touch drawer on mobile.
layout_and_grids.top_hud_bar: Fixed header with team toggle tabs (CANYON TEAM A vs CANYON TEAM B), quick tactical stats, autosave status indicator, map replace button, export PNG high-res trigger, and Help Dialog trigger.
layout_and_grids.workspace_canvas: Pan & Zoom viewport with touch gestures (pinch-zoom, multi-touch drag, wheel zoom, zoom controls reset/in/out). Interactive Canvas Layer holding the sci-fi isometric map, SVG tactical trajectory vectors & animated directional arrows, 12 selectable building hotspots, and glowing tactical nameplates.
layout_and_grids.sidebar_drawer: Squad Assignment Console with building quick-filter, squad leader input, multi-player roster management, tactical roles (Assault, Medic, Recon, Heavy, Engineer), quick copy between teams, and clear action with verification dialog.
layout_and_grids.tactical_vector_overlay: Holographic arrows connecting spawn zones to defenses, warehouses, serum caches, virus lab, and central power tower with pulsing dashes and chevron pointers.

motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-out, transition-opacity duration-200 ease-out, transition-transform duration-200 ease-out
motion.glow_pulse: animate-pulse (subtle 2s loop on critical hotspots and leader badges)
motion.holographic_scanlines: CSS subtle scanline linear-gradient with 0.04 opacity over map workspace
motion.selection_ring: Pulsing cyan bounding box with corner crosshairs when a building is selected
motion.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion by removing pulsing rings and disabling map pan animations.

accessibility.contrast_guarantee: All text tokens exceed WCAG AA 4.5:1. Cyan accents are checked against deep obsidian navy backgrounds.
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full arrow key and tab navigation between structures, hotspots, and squad assignment form fields.
accessibility.aria_roles: Role='tablist' on Team Switcher, role='region' on Map Canvas with aria-label, role='dialog' on Help and Export previews.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for hotspot pins, buttons, and mobile drawer handles.

components.name: TacticalHeader
components.description: Top bar showing Team A / Team B toggle, holographic title 'CANYON TEAM A' / 'CANYON TEAM B', export PNG button, map upload button, hotspot edit mode toggle, help modal button, and autosave status badge with timestamp.

components.name: BattleMapCanvas
components.description: Interactive pan/zoom container supporting mouse drag, wheel zoom, pinch-to-zoom on mobile, tactical SVG arrows layer, building hotspot markers with selection rings, and attached glowing blue squad nameplates.

components.name: TacticalNameplate
components.description: Holographic glowing blue tag rendered beneath each structure. Shows Squad Leader badge (gold/cyan star + name) and list of assigned Allied Players with count tag. In-place quick editing trigger.

components.name: AssignmentPanel
components.description: Desktop side panel and mobile slide-up sheet allowing squad leader input, tag-based player addition/removal, player role assignment, building activation toggle, clear building squad, and team copy/clone tools.

components.name: TacticalArrowsOverlay
components.description: SVG vector paths with animated dashed strokes and arrowheads connecting spawn points to objectives, custom toggleable attack/defense vectors for both teams.

components.name: HotspotEditorOverlay
components.description: Draggable pin manager enabled in 'Edit Hotspots' mode. Allows dragging all 12 structure pins to align with user-uploaded custom isometric map images and resetting to defaults.

components.name: ExportModal
components.description: Renders high-res 2x/4x PNG tactical briefing export with custom banner title (CANYON TEAM A / B), high-res rasterized map with vector arrows, all glowing nameplates, squad rosters, and direct download.

components.name: HelpInstructionsDialog
components.description: Comprehensive tactical briefing modal explaining team navigation, structure selection, leader & squad assignments, zooming & panning, editing hotspot anchors, custom map uploads, and PNG export features.

components.name: MapUploaderDialog
components.description: Allows uploading custom isometric sci-fi battlefield image or switching back to high-res sci-fi defaults, previewing aspect ratio and applying across both Team A and Team B.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the app in /app/frontend/src/ with strict TypeScript and Tailwind v4 CSS variables in /app/frontend/src/index.css.
Use @fontsource-variable/space-grotesk for headings and @fontsource-variable/geist for sans body.
Persist all assignments and custom hotspots in browser localStorage under key 'canyon_tactical_planner_state' with automatic debounced saving and visual 'Autosaved' HUD indicator.
Ensure both CANYON TEAM A and CANYON TEAM B maintain distinct squad rosters and active structure selections, while sharing the map background image and calibrated hotspot coordinates.

For High-Resolution PNG export, use html-to-image or direct 2D canvas synthesis to guarantee clean output without missing fonts or cross-origin canvas taint. Include prominent 'CANYON TEAM A' / 'CANYON TEAM B' header and watermark in the exported image.
Provide a sleek default sci-fi isometric canvas with fallback SVG isometric buildings rendering in case an image fails to load, ensuring zero broken visuals.
Mobile-first responsive layout: ensure the map canvas fills the viewport with intuitive pinch/pan controls, and the assignment panel morphs into a smooth draggable bottom sheet on screens < 768px.

Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='team-a-tab', data-testid='team-b-tab', data-testid='structure-power-tower', data-testid='export-png-button', data-testid='leader-input', data-testid='add-player-btn').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: No AI slop or generic corporate cards. Use crisp tactical HUD aesthetic with 1px border lines, corner accents, and cyan glow highlights.
Ensure every hover and focus state has explicit high-contrast colors.
Use Sonner for tactical HUD notifications ('Assignments saved', 'Exporting tactical briefing...', 'Hotspot calibration updated').
All interactive elements must have minimum 44px touch targets on mobile viewports.
